five_keyframe_trilogy.label_zh: 遠距蓄力（未碰泡前・大氣隙）
近泡逼近（未碰泡前・微氣隙）
持柄接觸（底面貼合發光母錨點）
衝擊碎裂（底光擴散與放射裂紋）
史詩爆破尾幀（泡殼向外炸裂）

video_transition_manifest.transition_prompt: Continuous 0.0s->2.0s interpolation (遠距蓄力（未碰泡前・大氣隙） -> 近泡逼近（未碰泡前・微氣隙）); keep C13 radial dark-steel cylinder, 100% bare lower-left circular cap, and upper-left 90° straight rod locked.
Continuous 2.0s->4.5s interpolation (近泡逼近（未碰泡前・微氣隙） -> 持柄接觸（底面貼合發光母錨點）); keep C13 radial dark-steel cylinder, 100% bare lower-left circular cap, and upper-left 90° straight rod locked.
Continuous 4.5s->7.0s interpolation (持柄接觸（底面貼合發光母錨點） -> 衝擊碎裂（底光擴散與放射裂紋）); keep C13 radial dark-steel cylinder, 100% bare lower-left circular cap, and upper-left 90° straight rod locked.
Continuous 7.0s->10.0s interpolation (衝擊碎裂（底光擴散與放射裂紋） -> 史詩爆破尾幀（泡殼向外炸裂）); keep C13 radial dark-steel cylinder, 100% bare lower-left circular cap, and upper-left 90° straight rod locked.
